cs.t: A Macbook (black) with a triple-monitor display (internal display + 2 x 24" Acer 1080p monitors on either side). I'm using the EVGA UV Plus+16, which is a USB-to-DVI adapter for the second external monitor, which is really nice, but it only allows the one monitor to go up to 1680x1050, so I just use that monitor for email, IM, IRC, etc, where it doesn't really matter.
